messages:
deploy-bot: image publish started for inference-service:v3.4.1-rc (sha: 9f3a1d2) -> staging
jen: heads-up, this is the RC with the new KV-cache change. expected size ~1.8GB
kevin: what registry? ghcr or our internal mirror?
deploy-bot: pushing to ghcr.io/redwood/inference:staging-v3.4.1-rc
ops-ci: build log: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 — started build, uploading layers
deploy-bot: layer upload 4/9 failed: 413 Request Entity Too Large. retrying with chunked upload
```
# curl upload layer
HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
Server: nginx
Content-Length: 0
```
kevin: seen that when the proxy chunk limit was hit. ops-infra, any recent proxy config changes?
ops-ci: infra change this morning bumped max_body_size, but nginx in front of our registry still on old config. filing infra ticket (INFRA-382).
maria: re: scans — can we delay deploy if image scan fails? we had a flaky scanner earlier.
deploy-bot: image uploaded, pushing manifest... manifest push succeeded -> digest sha256:abc123def456
deploy-bot: security scan started (trivy)
deploy-bot: scan result: HIGH vuln in libssl found in image layer 5. action: quarantined
jen: oh no. is it a false positive due to vendored lib?
kevin: can we patch quickly? otherwise rollback to v3.4.0 pin for canary.
sre-oncall: recommend pinning traffic to v3.4.0 in staging and holding rollout. open rollback runbook? :warning:
jen: I'm pulling a patch branch now. if we can't patch in 2 hours, we'll pin back.
ops-ci: I can re-trigger a build with updated base image that has patched libssl.
deploy-bot: manual intervention required. image marked quarantine: true. registry tag inference:staging-v3.4.1-rc detached
maria: create a quick release note entry: "v3.4.1-rc quarantined due to scan; holding rollout"
kevin: good. also add a note to the release window board. change-window 02:00-04:00 PST
sre-oncall: I've updated rollout policy: canary disabled for this tag, fallback to v3.4.0 pinned
jen: thanks. once ops-ci confirms rebuilt image with patched base and passes scan, we'll re-run push. ping me
deploy-bot: status: HOLD (quarantined). last_event: scan_failed. contact: #eng-releases
ops-ci: unlinking temp digest and scheduling rebuild: build_id 12346
maria: :thumbsup: keeping the incident as a ticket: INC-2026-87
kevin: adding note to changelog draft
jen: reassigning to release lead for next steps
deploy-bot: final: thread closed for now until rebuild completes."
